import re

SAMPLE = re.compile(r"^Each sample counts as (?P<interval>\S.*?)\.\s*$")
FLAT_HDR = re.compile(r"^\s*(?:%\s+cumulative\s+self\b|time\s+seconds\s+seconds\b)")
FLAT = re.compile(r"^\s*(?P<time>[\d.]+)\s+(?P<cumulative>[\d.]+)\s+(?P<self>[\d.]+)(?:\s+(?P<calls>\d+)\s+(?P<self_call>[\d.]+)\s+(?P<total_call>[\d.]+))?\s+(?P<name>\S.*?)\s*$")
GRAN = re.compile(r"^granularity: each sample hit covers (?P<bytes>\d+) byte\(s\) for (?P<pct>[\d.]+%) of (?P<total>[\d.]+ seconds)\s*$")
GRAPH_HDR = re.compile(r"^index\s+% time\s+self\s+children\s+called\s+name")
PRIMARY = re.compile(r"^\[(?P<index>\d+)\]\s+(?P<time>[\d.]+)\s+(?P<self>[\d.]+)\s+(?P<children>[\d.]+)(?:\s+(?P<called>\d+(?:\+\d+)?))?\s+(?P<name>\S.*?)\s+\[\d+\]\s*$")
ARC = re.compile(r"^\s+(?P<self>[\d.]+)\s+(?P<children>[\d.]+)\s+(?P<called>\d+(?:/\d+)?)\s+(?P<name>\S.*?)\s+\[(?P<index>\d+)\]\s*$")
SPONT = re.compile(r"^\s+<spontaneous>\s*$")
RULE = re.compile(r"^-{5,}\s*$")
INDEX_ITEM = re.compile(r"^\[(?P<index>\d+)\]\s+(?P<name>\S.*?)$")
TITLE = re.compile(r"^\s*(?:Flat profile:|Call graph|Index by function name)\s*$")


def parse(lines):
    info, flat, entries, arcs, index = {}, [], [], [], []
    used = {"info": [], "flat": [], "entries": [], "arcs": [], "index": []}
    skip = []
    section = "flat"
    group = []          # the arc lines of the call-graph entry being read
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        if TITLE.match(ln):
            skip.append(j)
            if ln.strip().startswith("Call graph"):
                section = "graph"
            elif ln.strip().startswith("Index by"):
                section = "index"
            continue
        if section == "flat":
            m = SAMPLE.match(ln)
            if m:
                info["sample interval"] = m.group("interval")
                used["info"].append(j)
                continue
            if FLAT_HDR.match(ln):
                used["flat"].append(j)
                continue
            m = FLAT.match(ln)
            if m:
                r = {k: (m.group(k) or "") for k in ("time", "cumulative", "self", "calls", "self_call", "total_call", "name")}
                flat.append({"% time": r["time"], "cumulative seconds": r["cumulative"], "self seconds": r["self"],
                             "calls": r["calls"], "self ms/call": r["self_call"], "total ms/call": r["total_call"],
                             "name": r["name"]})
                used["flat"].append(j)
            continue
        if section == "graph":
            m = GRAN.match(ln)
            if m:
                info["granularity bytes"] = m.group("bytes")
                info["granularity %"] = m.group("pct")
                info["total seconds"] = m.group("total")
                used["info"].append(j)
                continue
            if GRAPH_HDR.match(ln):
                used["entries"].append(j)
                continue
            if RULE.match(ln):
                skip.append(j)
                group = []
                continue
            m = PRIMARY.match(ln)
            if m:
                entry = {"index": m.group("index"), "% time": m.group("time"), "self": m.group("self"),
                         "children": m.group("children"), "called": m.group("called") or "", "name": m.group("name")}
                entries.append(entry)
                used["entries"].append(j)
                # the lines read so far in this group are the entry's callers
                for jj, arc in group:
                    arc["entry index"] = entry["index"]
                    arc["entry"] = entry["name"]
                    arc["role"] = "caller"
                    arcs.append(arc)
                    used["arcs"].append(jj)
                group = [None]
                continue
            m = ARC.match(ln)
            arc = None
            if m:
                arc = {"self": m.group("self"), "children": m.group("children"), "called": m.group("called"),
                       "name": m.group("name"), "index": m.group("index")}
            elif SPONT.match(ln):
                arc = {"self": "", "children": "", "called": "", "name": "<spontaneous>", "index": ""}
            if arc is None:
                continue
            if group and group[0] is None and entries:
                # after the primary line: a callee of the current entry
                arc = {"entry index": entries[-1]["index"], "entry": entries[-1]["name"], "role": "callee",
                       "self": arc["self"], "children": arc["children"], "called": arc["called"],
                       "name": arc["name"], "index": arc["index"]}
                arcs.append(arc)
                used["arcs"].append(j)
            else:
                group.append((j, arc))
            continue
        if section == "index":
            items = [INDEX_ITEM.match(p.strip()) for p in re.split(r"\s{2,}", ln.strip())]
            if items and all(items):
                for m in items:
                    index.append({"index": m.group("index"), "name": m.group("name")})
                used["index"].append(j)
    # one column order for callers and callees
    arcs = [{"entry index": a["entry index"], "entry": a["entry"], "role": a["role"], "self": a["self"],
             "children": a["children"], "called": a["called"], "name": a["name"], "index": a["index"]} for a in arcs]
    return {"blocks": [
        {"name": "profile", "kind": "kv", "lines": used["info"], "records": [info] if info else []},
        {"name": "flat profile", "kind": "table", "lines": used["flat"], "records": flat},
        {"name": "call graph entries", "kind": "table", "lines": used["entries"], "records": entries},
        {"name": "call graph callers and callees", "kind": "table", "lines": used["arcs"], "records": arcs},
        {"name": "function index", "kind": "table", "lines": used["index"], "records": index}],
        "skip": skip}
